Objects.Name: compaction_evidence
Objects.SQL: CREATE TABLE compaction_evidence(sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,compaction_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES compactions(id),at INTEGER NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL)

Objects.Name: compactions
Objects.SQL: CREATE TABLE compactions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,scope TEXT NOT NULL,turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,at INTEGER NOT NULL,end_at INTEGER,reason TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',tokens_before INTEGER,tokens_after INTEGER,entry_id TEXT)

Objects.Name: request_routes
Objects.SQL: CREATE TABLE request_routes(request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES requests(id),provider TEXT NOT NULL,generation INTEGER NOT NULL,spec_hash TEXT NOT NULL,agent TEXT NOT NULL,profile_id TEXT NOT NULL)

Objects.Name: requests
Objects.SQL: CREATE TABLE requests(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,scope TEXT NOT NULL,turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,at INTEGER NOT NULL,model TEXT NOT NULL,input INTEGER,output INTEGER,cache INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,reserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',compaction_id TEXT,input_estimate INTEGER NOT NULL,output_cap INTEGER NOT NULL,original TEXT NOT NULL, cache_reported INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

Objects.Name: routing_turns
Objects.SQL: CREATE TABLE routing_turns(turn_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

Objects.Name: settings
Objects.SQL: CREATE TABLE settings(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)

Objects.Name: tools
Objects.SQL: CREATE TABLE tools(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,scope TEXT NOT NULL,turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,at INTEGER NOT NULL,end_at INTEGER,bytes INTEGER,failed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

Objects.Name: wait_release_requests
Objects.SQL: CREATE TABLE wait_release_requests(owner TEXT NOT NULL,request_id TEXT NOT NULL,scope TEXT NOT NULL,turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,since INTEGER NOT NULL,complete INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(owner,request_id))

Objects.Name: wait_sequences
Objects.SQL: CREATE TABLE wait_sequences(scope TEXT PRIMARY KEY,since INTEGER NOT NULL)

Objects.Name: waits
Objects.SQL: CREATE TABLE waits(scope TEXT PRIMARY KEY,turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,at INTEGER NOT NULL,reset_at INTEGER NOT NULL,required INTEGER NOT NULL,released INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,provider TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')
